[[The Earthturner]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Joknang Earthturner]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Bahdok Caverns]].

==Stats==
:[[Earth damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Earth Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[Earth Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Greater Ancient Rod]].
